item.title: Ventura Foods recalls multiple salad dressings in WA over foreign material concern
item.description: Ventura Foods is recalling several salad dressings after black plastic planting material was discovered in granulated onion used in the products.

item.title: State trooper injured in head-on collision in Lakewood, WA
item.description: A Washington State Patrol sergeant suffered only minor injuries after a pickup truck hit his cruiser head-on in Lakewood on Wednesday morning.

item.title: SHINee’s KEY brings ‘KEYLAND: Uncanny Valley’ Tour to a close in Seattle
item.description: SHINee’s KEY wrapped up his first U.S. tour in Seattle, celebrating 18 years of music, artistry, and connection with fans across generations.

item.title: RESCENE opens up about expectations, teamwork, and their latest album
item.description: With their latest album “lip bomb,” K-pop group RESCENE is showing new sides of themselves. The group talks concept, confidence, and connection with fans.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks rule out Charles Cross; Jason Myers named Special Teams Player of the Week
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks ruled out left tackle Charles Cross from playing in Thursday night's game against the Los Angeles Rams due to a hamstring injury as Josh Jones will make the start in his place.

item.title: US 2 closure leaves Skykomish, WA businesses stranded after flooding
item.description: Forty-two miles of U.S. Highway 2 remain closed after floodwaters washed out the roadway just east of Skykomish, leaving state leaders scrambling for solutions.

item.title: Windstorm cuts power for more than 20,000 homes on WA's Whidbey Island
item.description: Communities across western Washington went dark after a powerful windstorm swept through overnight, but few places were hit as hard as Whidbey Island.

item.title: WA Weather: Widespread rain, breezy winds and mountain snow Thursday
item.description: Widespread rain and breezy winds will return Thursday, along with more mountain snow.

item.title: Alex Carpenter scores twice as Seattle Torrent beat Charge 4-1
item.description: Alex Carpenter had two goals and an assist, and Hannah Bilka had a goal and two assists as the Seattle Torrent earned a 4-1 victory over the Ottawa Charge on Wednesday night.

item.title: Tacoma, WA family with medical needs makes plea to restore power, crews respond
item.description: Over 25,000 Pierce County residents were left in the dark Wednesday night after a windstorm pounded western Washington, with impacts lasting throughout the day.
